tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included. Local and development testing that needs a TLS endpoint uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that local testing uses self-signed certificates instead of turning verification off.

I took this from the two current Muninn decisions, "Verification on all builds going forward" and "testing with self-signed certificates instead". Both retired records for this topic (#19 and #29) were left out, and the file describes none of the retired alternatives.

A shell command to create the file failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I didn't re-read the file afterwards.
